tests.result: HEAD cb92aac5199e9c2a4bdeb540ad42ddd4e2d07c61 on main. Assigned files match HEAD (diff exit 0). Existing unrelated App edits were not touched.

Inspected both files in full. Replacement validates recovery input before acquiring the shared transaction lock; reads and validates the current library without legacy migration; appends without deletion when capacity is available; otherwise compares the complete candidate record, requires an archived inactive candidate, then deletes/inserts in a local snapshot before one size-checked atomic write. All noncandidate records originate from the current snapshot. Ordinary save and both recovery paths use the same process-wide lock, so an ordinary stale save cannot overwrite a completed recovery within the documented process contract.

Assertions compare all surviving records, preserving their identities and values. These methods were not executed by this worker.
